name: What is the difference between a standalone fence installation and integrating a fence into a complete outdoor living renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a standalone fence installation and integrating a fence into a complete outdoor living renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standalone fence installation typically focuses solely on the fence itself, often with a contractor specializing only in fencing. Integrating a fence into a complete outdoor living renovation, as AKN Design Group provides, involves considering the fence as one component of a larger, cohesive design. This means the fence is chosen and installed to complement elements like custom patios, outdoor kitchens, and landscaping, ensuring a unified aesthetic and functionality. Our design-build approach provides a single point of coordination for the entire transformation, preventing disconnected outcomes and enhancing overall value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standalone fence installation focuses only on the fence, while integrated fencing considers it part of a larger, cohesive outdoor living design. Our design-build process ensures unified aesthetics and functionality.
